d:
This song is a LOFI version of ' Samay Samjhayega ' from Radha krishn television series. It's composed by Surya Raj Kamal, sung by MOhit lalwani, penned by Shekhar Astitwa and music by Bharat Kamal, Radhe Radhe.
Credits:
Singer - MOhit lalwani
Composer - Surya Raj Kamal,
Lyrics - Shekhar Astitwa
Music - Bharat Kamal
Radha Krishna painting by- Teju Jangid
